slot.brief: Arrange given Group 16 hydrides by boiling point / thermal stability or Group 13 oxides by acidity, testing anomalous trends.

stem: Which is the correct decreasing order of thermal stability of the Group 15 hydrides?

verdicts.working: Thermal stability decreases down Group 15 as the E–H bond weakens: NH₃ > PH₃ > AsH₃ > SbH₃.

working:
$\text{M-H}$ bond strength decreases down Group 15 as the central atom gets larger.
Thermal stability follows the $\text{M-H}$ bond strength.
Hence, $\text{NH}_3 > \text{PH}_3 > \text{AsH}_3 > \text{SbH}_3$.

Independent check: Thermal stability decreases down Group 15 as the E–H bond weakens: NH₃ > PH₃ > AsH₃ > SbH₃.
